# pidginhost_kubernetes_route (Resource)

A Gateway API route that exposes a Kubernetes Service through the cluster gateway. The route the platform keeps for the Kubernetes API cannot be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_kubernetes_route" "web" {
  cluster_id           = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  protocol             = "http"
  name                 = "web"
  hostnames            = ["example.com", "www.example.com"]
  backend_service_name = "web"
  backend_service_port = 80
}

resource "pidginhost_kubernetes_route" "dns" {
  cluster_id           = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  protocol             = "udp"
  name                 = "dns"
  port                 = 5353
  backend_service_name = "dns"
  backend_service_port = 53
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_service_name` (String) Name of the backend Service.
- `backend_service_port` (Number) Port of the backend Service.
- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster. Changing it replaces the object.
- `name` (String) Route name. Changing it replaces the route.
- `protocol` (String) Route type: http routes match host names, tcp and udp routes expose an external port. Changing it replaces the route.

### Optional

- `backend_namespace` (String) Namespace of the backend Service. The API uses default when not set.
- `enable_tls` (Boolean) Terminate TLS with an automatically issued certificate. Only for http routes; the API enables it when not set.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Host names the route matches. Required for http routes, not valid for others.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the route. Defaults to default. Changing it replaces the route.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix the route matches. Only for http routes; the API uses / when not set.
- `port` (Number) External port to expose. Required for tcp and udp routes, not valid for http. The API refuses the TCP ports 22, 6443, 50000 and 50001.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object in the PidginHost API.
- `status_message` (String) Status message from the gateway.
- `status_ready` (Boolean) Whether the gateway reports the route ready. Unknown while it has not reported yet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a route as <cluster_id>/<protocol>/<route_id>.
terraform import pidginhost_kubernetes_route.web 7/http/4
```
